title: terraform import and data sources for cloudflare_ai_search_instance fail after upgrading to provider v5.29.0
symptoms: terraform import cloudflare_ai_search_instance.docs /docs fails with an invalid import ID
data "cloudflare_ai_search_instance" or data "cloudflare_ai_search_instances" fails validation because namespace is missing
filter.namespace on the cloudflare_ai_search_instance data source is rejected as an unsupported argument
plan shows an instance being replaced after namespace is changed
cause: Provider v5.29.0 added a namespace argument to cloudflare_ai_search_instance. The import ID now has three parts, the two data sources require namespace, and the old filter.namespace argument was removed. Changing namespace on an existing instance forces replacement.
fix: Use the three-part import ID with default as the namespace for existing instances. Add namespace = "default" to every instance data source block, remove filter.namespace, and do not change namespace on a live instance unless you accept a replace.
apply:
terraform import cloudflare_ai_search_instance.docs <account_id>/default/docs

# data source
data "cloudflare_ai_search_instance" "docs" {
  account_id = var.account_id
  namespace  = "default"
  id         = "docs"
}
affected: Cloudflare Terraform provider v5.29.0 and later, announced 2026-11-13
